must: preserve supplied desktop and mobile calculator compositions
remain usable from 320px phones through wide desktops
show source provenance and token-count accuracy
avoid: gradient-heavy surfaces outside the intentionally premium cost numerals

decisions: Warm near-white editorial canvas with black ink and restrained blue only for code syntax/focus.
Premium feel comes from typography, spacing, thin rules, responsive hierarchy, and short motion—not decorative effects.
Desktop uses editor and analysis side by side; mobile promotes cost first and keeps the editor below.
New sharing uses eight-character private Blob slugs with 30-day expiry; the URL-fragment reader remains for legacy links.
Cost numerals use a broad pearl-graphite satin gradient, heavier tabular typography, a seamless 24-second drift, length-aware fitting, and a 420ms staged compositor transition between values.
The calculator canvas includes two restrained ambient light planes behind the workspace, moving only a few pixels over 26-32 seconds.
PNG receipts render locally at 1200×800 with syntax-colored code and no image API request.
